items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Louie Warnick used to work for Eugene Deeson and he used to go to New York with his company all the time. And I used to work one and two months at a time.

ctx.x: Yeah, I played with Des Dominguez. You ever played with P-Roll? Yeah. Oh, yeah. I played with P-Roll all the time. I used to play—I used to play in—how'd they call this place? Tell your tail? I said, no. Tell that fellow. One used to play saxophone when they died. Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick. I used to play Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick used to work for Eugene Deeson and he used to go to New York with his company all the time. And I used to work one and two months at a time.
There was the Blueprint. The Blueprint company? The Blueprint company?
